_comment: Hand-curated licence-name -> EPIAS powerplant id mappings. Automatic name matching cannot find these because EPIAS files the plant under a different name. Each entry was verified by checking that the EPIAS record's peak hourly output is consistent with the licensed capacity — a candidate whose peak is a small fraction of the licence is a different, smaller plant. Adding an entry and re-running seed_hydro_plants.py pulls the plant in; an entry may also move an id that automatic matching assigned to the wrong licence.

aliases.note: EPIAS files the Yedigöze dam on the Seyhan under its Sanibey name.
Peak 79.1 MW against 86.7 MW licensed; province matches.

The Giresun plant displaced by the correction above. Peak 36.0 MW against 39.8 MW licensed.

Swap: the id was on ULUDERE HES (0.7 MW) but the record peaks at 3.4 MW, matching this 3.5 MW plant.
